scope: Bounded v1 workflows for seven AI areas; not completion of every advanced modality/task in the master roadmap

answer.text: GPU training requires an explicitly installed compatible backend.

statistical.data: sklearn bundled Iris + explicit synthetic causal simulation
statistical.limitations: No causal identification from data alone; no guarantee of active/semi-supervised improvement.

real_graph.scope: Transductive homogeneous undirected node classification, not unseen-graph/heterogeneous/link prediction acceptance

media.scope: Synthetic tone/color classification wiring and codecs; not speech recognition, video understanding or natural-data quality

representation.scope: Synthetic two-view representation learning and nine-example prototype support; not general few-shot/continual-learning quality

recorded_audio.scope: Actual recorded speech/whistle PCM decoding and feature extraction only; no ASR or real-data classifier quality claim

graph_data.source: NetworkX3.7 karate_club_graph; underlying Zachary karate club dataset
graph_data.scope: Transductive; topology/features visible, 32 held-out labels excluded from loss

known_limits: No ASR/TTS, general video understanding or graph-family completeness claim.
Iris entropy-query active accuracy fell from95.56% to91.11%; no improvement claim.
Audio/video learned quality uses generated tones/colors; actual recorded audio acceptance covers decoding/features only.
Causal interval/estimate is validated on a known-effect simulation under stated identification assumptions.
FFmpeg decoding is an explicit external backend; ordinary import/install never starts it or installs it.

source_suite.note: Absent optional backends/targets may skip in source suites; installed profiles require zero skips.
